scholarships.name: PM-USP Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College & University Students (CSSS)
scholarships.provider: Ministry of Education, Department of Higher Education
scholarships.forWhom: Students above the 80th percentile in their Class 12 board, in regular degree courses (not diploma/distance), family income up to ₹4.5 lakh.
scholarships.amount: ₹12,000/yr (UG years 1–3), ₹20,000/yr (PG and years 4–5 of professional/integrated courses)
scholarships.deadline: AY 2026-27: only renewals open on NSP, closing 31 Oct 2026; check NSP for fresh applications
scholarships.notes: 82,000 fresh scholarships/yr, 50% for girls. Renewal needs 50% marks and 75% attendance. Can't be combined with other merit/state scholarships or fee waivers. B.Tech/B.E. get ₹12,000 for years 1–3 and ₹20,000 in year 4.

scholarships.name: PM-USP Special Scholarship Scheme for J&K and Ladakh (SSS J&K and Ladakh)
scholarships.provider: Ministry of Education (implemented by AICTE)
scholarships.forWhom: Domicile of J&K or Ladakh who passed Class 12 there (JKBOSE/CBSE) and takes UG admission outside the UTs through AICTE's online counselling (medical seats via NEET counselling); income up to ₹8 lakh.
scholarships.amount: Academic fee up to ₹30,000/yr (general degree), ₹1.25 lakh/yr (professional/engineering), ₹3 lakh/yr (medical) + ₹1 lakh/yr maintenance
scholarships.deadline: Fresh: via AICTE counselling portal; renewals on NSP (AY 2026-27 renewals close 31 Oct 2026)
scholarships.applyVia: AICTE PM-USP (SSS J&K & Ladakh) portal for fresh admission; NSP for renewals
scholarships.notes: 5,000 fresh scholarships/yr. Only for admission in listed institutions outside J&K/Ladakh (NAAC 3.0+, NIRF top 100, etc.). Not for diploma, PG, management quota or open university.

scholarships.name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girl Students (Degree & Diploma)
scholarships.provider: AICTE, Ministry of Education
scholarships.forWhom: Girls in 1st year (or 2nd year via lateral entry) of an AICTE-approved technical degree or diploma; max 2 girls per family.
scholarships.amount: ₹50,000/yr for each year of study
scholarships.deadline: NSP AY 2026-27: applications 1 Jun–31 Oct 2026 (per NSP listing); check portal for next cycle
scholarships.notes: Merit-based on 12th marks (degree) or 10th marks (diploma), state-wise. All eligible applicant girls from NE states and some UTs (incl. J&K, Ladakh) get it. Gap after qualifying exam max 2 years. Cannot hold another scholarship.

scholarships.name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship for Specially-Abled Students (Degree & Diploma)
scholarships.provider: AICTE, Ministry of Education
scholarships.forWhom: Students with 40%+ disability in 1st year (or lateral-entry 2nd year) of an AICTE-approved technical degree or diploma.
scholarships.amount: ₹50,000/yr for each year of study
scholarships.deadline: NSP AY 2026-27: applications 1 Jun–31 Oct 2026 (per NSP listing); check portal for next cycle
scholarships.notes: All eligible applicants get it (no fixed cap). Disabled students must first give UDID consent on the UDID portal before applying on NSP.

scholarships.name: AICTE Swanath Scholarship Scheme
scholarships.provider: AICTE, Ministry of Education
scholarships.forWhom: Orphans, students who lost a parent to Covid-19, wards of armed/paramilitary forces martyrs, or students whose parent has a critical life-threatening illness or died/was 80%+ disabled in an accident; in an AICTE-approved degree or diploma course.
scholarships.amount: ₹50,000/yr for each remaining year of study
scholarships.deadline: NSP AY 2026-27: applications 1 Jun–31 Oct 2026 (per NSP listing); check portal for next cycle
scholarships.notes: Up to 2,000/yr (1,000 degree, 1,000 diploma). Open to students in any year of a regular AICTE-approved degree/diploma; must not hold any other central/state/AICTE scholarship.

scholarships.name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship (NMMSS)
scholarships.provider: Ministry of Education, Department of School Education & Literacy
scholarships.forWhom: Class 8 students of government, aided or local-body schools who clear the state NMMSS exam (needs 55% in Class 7); paid in Classes 9–12.
scholarships.amount: ₹12,000/yr (₹1,000/month), Class 9 to 12
scholarships.deadline: NSP AY 2026-27: applications 1 Jun–31 Oct 2026 (per NSP listing); check portal for next cycle
scholarships.notes: 1 lakh new scholarships/yr, state quotas. Selection via state-run MAT + SAT exam in Class 8. Not for Kendriya Vidyalaya, Navodaya, govt residential or private school students. Continuing in Class 11 needs 60% in Class 10.

scholarships.name: National Scholarship for Post Graduate Studies (UGC)
scholarships.provider: University Grants Commission (UGC)
scholarships.forWhom: First-year regular PG students (first PG degree only) under 30 at admission, in NAAC-accredited/central-funded institutions; all-India merit.
scholarships.amount: ₹15,000/month for 10 months (₹1.5 lakh/yr) for 2 years
scholarships.deadline: NSP AY 2026-27: 16 Sep–31 Oct 2026 (per NSP listing)
scholarships.notes: 10,000 slots/yr. 30% reserved for women, filled first by single/twin girl child applicants regardless of UG marks. Replaces the old PG Indira Gandhi single girl child and rank-holder scholarships.

scholarships.name: Ishan Uday Special Scholarship Scheme for North Eastern Region
scholarships.provider: University Grants Commission (UGC)
scholarships.forWhom: NE domicile students who passed Class 12 from a school in the NE region, now in 1st year of a regular UG degree anywhere in India.
scholarships.amount: ₹8,000/month for 10 months (₹80,000/yr) for the UG course
scholarships.deadline: Check the UGC Ishan Uday page for the 2026-27 application portal
scholarships.notes: 10,000 slots/yr, state-wise merit on Class 12 marks. Management-quota and distance students not eligible. Institution must be NAAC-accredited (from AY 2025-26) or centrally funded/INI.

scholarships.name: PM YASASVI Top Class Education in Schools for OBC, EBC & DNT
scholarships.provider: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment (Backward Classes)
scholarships.forWhom: OBC/EBC/DNT students in Classes 9–12 at notified 'Top Class Schools' (100% board results), selected on previous-class marks.
scholarships.amount: Up to ₹75,000/yr (Class 9–10) and ₹1.25 lakh/yr (Class 11–12) for school fees and hostel
scholarships.deadline: NSP AY 2026-27 fresh applications: 22 Oct–30 Nov 2026 (per NSP listing)
scholarships.notes: At least 30% of slots for girls; state-wise merit. NSP notice (Oct 2026): students from Rajasthan, Kerala and Karnataka must wait to apply.

scholarships.name: PM YASASVI Top Class Education in College for OBC, EBC & DNT
scholarships.provider: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment (Backward Classes)
scholarships.forWhom: OBC/EBC/DNT students admitted to notified top institutions (IITs, IIMs, AIIMS, NITs, NLUs, NIFT, etc.) after Class 12.
scholarships.amount: Full tuition (private institutes capped at ₹2 lakh/yr) + ₹3,000/month living + ₹5,000/yr books + one-time ₹45,000 computer
scholarships.deadline: NSP AY 2026-27: applications 1 Jun–31 Oct 2026 (per NSP listing); check portal for next cycle
scholarships.notes: Fixed slots per institution, filled by inter-se merit; 30% for girls. Max 2 siblings per family. Others in these institutes fall back to post-matric scholarship.

scholarships.name: PM YASASVI Pre-Matric Scholarship for OBC, EBC & DNT Students
scholarships.provider: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment (implemented by States/UTs)
scholarships.forWhom: OBC, EBC or DNT students in Class 9 or 10 in a government school.
scholarships.deadline: Set by each State/UT on NSP or state portal; check your state
scholarships.applyVia: National Scholarship Portal or your State scholarship portal
scholarships.notes: Centrally sponsored; the state of domicile runs the application. Cannot hold another scholarship for Class 9–10.

scholarships.name: PM YASASVI Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC, EBC & DNT Students
scholarships.provider: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment (implemented by States/UTs)
scholarships.forWhom: OBC, EBC or DNT students in any recognised post-Class 10 course (Class 11 up to PhD).
scholarships.amount: ₹5,000/yr (non-degree post-Class 10) up to ₹20,000/yr (professional degree/PG courses), incl. tuition component; general BA/BSc/MA ₹8,000/yr
scholarships.deadline: Set by each State/UT on NSP or state portal; check your state
scholarships.applyVia: National Scholarship Portal or your State scholarship portal
scholarships.notes: Central guideline rates by course group: Group 1 ₹20,000, Group 2 ₹13,000, Group 3 ₹8,000, Group 4 ₹5,000 per year. Correspondence/online courses not eligible for academic allowance. States may add their own top-ups.

scholarships.name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Caste Students (Class 9–10)
scholarships.provider: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment (implemented by States/UTs)
scholarships.forWhom: SC students studying full-time in Class 9 or 10.
scholarships.amount: ₹3,500/yr (day scholars), ₹7,000/yr (hostellers); +10% for students with disabilities
scholarships.deadline: Set by each State/UT; check NSP/state portal
scholarships.applyVia: National Scholarship Portal (initial registration) then State portal
scholarships.notes: Centrally sponsored; awarded by the state of domicile.

scholarships.name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Children of Parents in Unclean & Hazardous Occupations
scholarships.provider: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment (implemented by States/UTs)
scholarships.forWhom: Class 1–10 children of manual scavengers, tanners/flayers, waste pickers or workers in hazardous cleaning, of any caste or religion.
scholarships.amount: ₹3,500/yr (day scholars), ₹8,000/yr (hostellers, Class 3–10)
scholarships.deadline: Set by each State/UT; check NSP/state portal
scholarships.applyVia: National Scholarship Portal (initial registration) then State portal
scholarships.notes: No income ceiling. Needs a certificate of parent's occupation from the District Social Welfare Officer or local body.

scholarships.name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Caste Students (PMS-SC)
scholarships.provider: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment (implemented by States/UTs)
scholarships.forWhom: SC students in any recognised post-Class 10 course (Class 11 up to PhD) in India, selected by their state of domicile.
scholarships.deadline: Set by each State/UT; check NSP/state portal
scholarships.applyVia: National Scholarship Portal or your State scholarship portal
scholarships.notes: Covers compulsory non-refundable fees plus an academic allowance that varies by course group and hosteller/day-scholar status. Income limit is ₹2.5 lakh in current guidelines; a raise to ₹4.5 lakh was reported as proposed in 2026, so check your state portal.

scholarships.name: Central Sector Scholarship of Top Class Education for SC Students
scholarships.provider: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment
scholarships.forWhom: SC students admitted to notified top institutions (IITs, IIMs, AIIMS, NITs, NLUs, etc.) for courses after Class 12.
scholarships.amount: Full tuition & non-refundable fees (private institutes capped at ₹2 lakh/yr) + ₹86,000 academic allowance in year 1, ₹41,000/yr after
scholarships.deadline: NSP AY 2026-27: applications 1 Jun–31 Oct 2026 (per NSP listing); check portal for next cycle
scholarships.notes: Fixed slots per institution, filled by merit; 30% for girls. SC students not selected can still claim Post-Matric Scholarship.

scholarships.name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Tribe Students (Class 9–10)
scholarships.provider: Ministry of Tribal Affairs (implemented by States/UTs)
scholarships.forWhom: ST students in Class 9 or 10 in a government or government-recognised school.
scholarships.amount: ₹225/month (day scholars) or ₹525/month (hostellers) for 10 months + ₹750/₹1,000 yearly books grant
scholarships.deadline: Set by each State/UT; check NSP/state portal
scholarships.applyVia: National Scholarship Portal or your State scholarship portal
scholarships.notes: Extra disability allowance of ₹600/month (day scholars) or ₹800/month (hostellers). Cannot hold another scholarship.

scholarships.name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Tribe Students
scholarships.provider: Ministry of Tribal Affairs (implemented by States/UTs)
scholarships.forWhom: ST students in any recognised course after Class 10 (Class 11 up to PhD).
scholarships.amount: Compulsory fees (up to the state-fixed limit) + maintenance of ₹230 to ₹1,200/month depending on course
scholarships.deadline: Set by each State/UT; check NSP/state portal
scholarships.applyVia: National Scholarship Portal or your State scholarship portal
scholarships.notes: Centrally sponsored; the state of domicile selects and pays.

scholarships.name: National Scholarship for Higher Education of ST Students (Top Class)
scholarships.provider: Ministry of Tribal Affairs
scholarships.forWhom: ST students admitted to UG/PG courses at premier institutes notified by the Ministry of Tribal Affairs.
scholarships.amount: Full tuition (private institutes capped at ₹2.5 lakh/yr) + ₹3,000/month stipend + ₹5,000/yr books + one-time ₹45,000 computer
scholarships.deadline: NSP AY 2026-27: applications 1 Jun–31 Oct 2026 (per NSP listing); check portal for next cycle
scholarships.notes: No institute/state cap on slots. Management-quota seats in private institutes not eligible. Formerly 'Top Class Education for ST Students'.

scholarships.name: National Fellowship for Higher Education of ST Students (NFST)
scholarships.provider: Ministry of Tribal Affairs
scholarships.forWhom: ST students who have qualified UGC-NET / Joint CSIR-UGC NET (required from 2025-26) and are admitted to a PhD at a recognised Indian university or institution; no income limit, max age 36.
scholarships.amount: ₹37,000/month (JRF, first 2 years), ₹42,000/month (SRF) – revised rates w.e.f. 1 Jan 2023
scholarships.deadline: 2025-26 call ran 1 Aug–30 Sep 2025 on fellowship.tribal.gov.in; check for the 2026-27 call
scholarships.notes: 750 slots (2025-26). Selection criteria changed from 2025-26 to use NET-JRF/CSIR results; see ministry notice.

scholarships.name: National Fellowship for Scheduled Caste Students (NFSC)
scholarships.provider: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment (implemented by NSFDC)
scholarships.forWhom: SC students who qualify UGC-NET or joint CSIR-UGC NET (NFSC category) and join MPhil/PhD at a UGC-recognised institution.
scholarships.amount: At par with UGC JRF/SRF rates (UGC: ₹37,000/month JRF, ₹42,000/month SRF)
scholarships.deadline: Selection through NTA's UGC-NET / CSIR-UGC NET; no separate application window
scholarships.applyVia: Choose NFSC while applying for UGC-NET / CSIR-UGC NET (NTA)
scholarships.notes: 2,000 new fellowships/yr (1,500 humanities/social sciences, 500 science), over and above normal reservation. Scheme guideline text still quotes older ₹31,000/₹35,000 rates, but ties the rate to UGC.

scholarships.name: National Fellowship for OBC Students (NF-OBC)
scholarships.provider: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment (UGC/NTA)
scholarships.forWhom: OBC students who qualify UGC-NET or CSIR-UGC NET for the NF-OBC category and enrol in a regular MPhil/PhD.
scholarships.amount: At par with UGC JRF/SRF rates (UGC: ₹37,000/month JRF, ₹42,000/month SRF)
scholarships.deadline: Selection through NTA's UGC-NET / CSIR-UGC NET; no separate application window
scholarships.notes: 1,000 slots/yr (750 UGC-NET, 250 CSIR-NET), over and above normal reservation. Ministry page still shows older ₹25,000/₹28,000 rates; the guideline ties rates to UGC fellowships. The ministry page still shows older rates; the scheme pays at current UGC JRF/SRF rates.

scholarships.name: National Fellowship for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (NFPwD)
scholarships.provider: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, MoSJE
scholarships.forWhom: Students with 40%+ benchmark disability who qualify UGC-NET JRF or CSIR-UGC NET JRF and pursue MPhil/PhD in India.
scholarships.amount: ₹37,000/month (JRF, 2 years), ₹42,000/month (SRF) + contingency + ₹2,000/month escort/reader allowance
scholarships.deadline: Selection through NTA's UGC-NET / CSIR-UGC NET
scholarships.notes: 200 fellowships/yr (150 UGC-NET, 50 CSIR-NET). No income ceiling. Awarded once in a lifetime; cannot combine with other stipends.

scholarships.name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
scholarships.provider: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, MoSJE
scholarships.forWhom: Students with 40%+ benchmark disability in Class 9 or 10.
scholarships.amount: ₹800/month (hostellers) or ₹500/month (day scholars) + ₹2,000–₹4,000/yr disability allowance + ₹1,000/yr books
scholarships.deadline: NSP AY 2026-27: 25 Jul–31 Oct 2026 (per NSP listing)
scholarships.notes: 25,000 slots incl. renewals, 50% for girls. Disability allowance is ₹4,000 for visual/intellectual disability, ₹2,000 for others. Give UDID consent on the UDID portal before applying.

scholarships.name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
scholarships.provider: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, MoSJE
scholarships.forWhom: Students with 40%+ benchmark disability in Class 11–12, diploma, UG or PG (up to Master's) at recognised institutions.
scholarships.amount: Tuition up to ₹1.4 lakh/yr + ₹1,200/month (hostellers) or ₹650/month (day scholars) + disability and ₹1,500/yr book allowance
scholarships.deadline: NSP AY 2026-27: 25 Jul–31 Oct 2026 (per NSP listing)
scholarships.notes: 17,000 slots incl. renewals, 50% for girls. Also up to ₹10,000/yr misc. fees. Not for a second course at the same level. UDID consent needed before applying.

scholarships.name: Top Class Education Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
scholarships.provider: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, MoSJE
scholarships.forWhom: Students with 40%+ benchmark disability in UG/PG degree or diploma courses at institutes notified by DEPwD.
scholarships.amount: Tuition up to ₹1.9 lakh/yr + ₹3,000/month (hostellers) or ₹1,500/month (day scholars) + one-time ₹45,000 laptop and ₹30,000 assistive devices
scholarships.deadline: NSP AY 2026-27: applications 1 Jun–31 Oct 2026 (per NSP listing); check portal for next cycle
scholarships.notes: 300 slots incl. renewals, 50% for girls. UDID consent needed before applying.

scholarships.name: UGC Junior Research Fellowship (NET-JRF) in Sciences, Humanities & Social Sciences
scholarships.provider: University Grants Commission (UGC) / NTA
scholarships.forWhom: Candidates who qualify NET-JRF or the joint CSIR-UGC NET and register for MPhil/PhD within the allowed period.
scholarships.amount: ₹37,000/month (JRF, 2 years), ₹42,000/month (SRF) + ₹10,000–₹25,000/yr contingency
scholarships.deadline: Through UGC-NET / CSIR-UGC NET exam cycles (NTA); no separate application
scholarships.notes: Tenure up to 5 years or thesis submission. CSIR-JRF holders in sciences are paid by CSIR at the same rates.

scholarships.name: Savitribai Jyotirao Phule Fellowship for Single Girl Child (UGC)
scholarships.provider: University Grants Commission (UGC)
scholarships.forWhom: A single girl child of her parents pursuing a PhD in any subject at a recognised university, college or institute.
scholarships.amount: ₹37,000/month (JRF, 2 years), ₹42,000/month (SRF) + contingency
scholarships.notes: Slots decided each year from eligible applications. Tenure up to 5 years or thesis submission.

scholarships.name: INSPIRE Scholarship for Higher Education (INSPIRE-SHE)
scholarships.provider: Department of Science & Technology (DST)
scholarships.forWhom: Top 1% Class 12 scorers of their board (or JEE/NEET top-10,000 rank holders) studying natural/basic sciences in B.Sc/BS/Int. M.Sc/MS.
scholarships.amount: ₹80,000/yr (₹60,000 scholarship + ₹20,000 summer research mentorship grant)
scholarships.deadline: No call for the 2025 or 2026 batch yet; 2024 was the last batch selected. DST says the scheme is being redesigned. Check online-inspire.gov.in
scholarships.notes: 12,000 scholarships/yr. Engineering, medicine and other professional courses not covered. Now runs under DST's Vigyan Dhara scheme; latest batch shown on the portal is SHE-2024, so check for a new call.

scholarships.name: Prime Minister's Research Fellowship (PMRF)
scholarships.provider: Ministry of Education
scholarships.forWhom: PhD scholars in science and engineering at IITs, IISERs, IISc and selected central universities/NITs (direct or lateral entry).
scholarships.amount: ₹70,000/month (years 1–2), ₹75,000 (year 3), ₹80,000 (years 4–5) + ₹2 lakh/yr research grant
scholarships.deadline: Not open: pmrf.in says all sanctioned seats are filled and further approval is awaited
scholarships.applyVia: PMRF portal (pmrf.in) through the host institute
scholarships.notes: Admissions currently paused per pmrf.in. Show as 'watch for reopening' rather than open.

scholarships.name: NEC Merit Scholarship (Financial Support to NER Students for Higher Professional Courses)
scholarships.provider: North Eastern Council, Ministry of DoNER
scholarships.forWhom: Students from the NE states with 60%+ in the qualifying exam, in professional diploma, degree, PG or MPhil/PhD courses anywhere in India.
scholarships.amount: ₹20,000/yr (diploma), ₹22,000/yr (degree), ₹25,000/yr (PG), ₹30,000/yr (MPhil/PhD)
scholarships.deadline: AY 2026-27 NSP listing shows renewals only (to 31 Oct 2026); fresh calls are advertised by NEC/state departments
scholarships.notes: Apply only in the first year of the course; later years are renewals. No caste/gender quota; state-wise slots. Not for sponsored/in-service candidates.

scholarships.name: Prime Minister's Scholarship Scheme for CAPF & Assam Rifles (and State Police martyrs' wards)
scholarships.provider: Ministry of Home Affairs
scholarships.forWhom: Wards/widows of serving, retired, disabled or deceased CAPF & Assam Rifles personnel, or of State/UT police martyred in terror/Naxal attacks, joining the first year of a first professional degree course (e.g. B.E./B.Tech, MBBS, BDS, BBA, BCA, B.Pharma) with 60%+ in the entry qualification.
scholarships.amount: ₹3,000/month (girls), ₹2,500/month (boys), paid annually
scholarships.deadline: NSP AY 2026-27: applications 1 Jun–31 Oct 2026 (per NSP listing); check portal for next cycle
scholarships.notes: First professional degree only (BE/B.Tech, MBBS, BDS, BBA, BCA, B.Pharm, B.Sc Nursing, etc.; MBA/MCA allowed). Fresh quota: 2,000 for CAPF/AR, 500 for state police. Max 2 children per family. Renewal needs 50% each year.

scholarships.name: Prime Minister's Scholarship Scheme for RPF/RPSF (Ministry of Railways)
scholarships.provider: Ministry of Railways (Railway Board)
scholarships.forWhom: Wards/widows of serving, retired or deceased RPF/RPSF personnel in their first year of a professional degree, with 60%+ in the entry qualification.
scholarships.amount: ₹3,000/month (girls), ₹2,500/month (boys)
scholarships.deadline: NSP AY 2026-27: applications 1 Jun–31 Oct 2026 (per NSP listing); check portal for next cycle
scholarships.notes: About 150 scholarships/yr. Professional degrees only (BE, B.Tech, MBBS, BDS, B.Ed, BBA, BCA, B.Pharm; MBA/MCA allowed). Max 2 wards per family.

scholarships.name: ICAR National Talent Scholarship (NTS-UG & NTS-PG)
scholarships.provider: Indian Council of Agricultural Research (DARE)
scholarships.forWhom: Students admitted under ICAR All India Quota seats (CUET-ICAR UG for bachelor's, ICAR AIEEA-PG for master's) to an agricultural university outside their home state; must keep OGPA 7.0/10 (6.5 for SC/ST).
scholarships.amount: ₹3,000/month (UG), ₹5,000/month (PG)
scholarships.deadline: NSP AY 2026-27: applications 1 Jun–31 Oct 2026 (per NSP listing); check portal for next cycle
scholarships.notes: Rates are from the 2016 ICAR guidelines linked on NSP. Confirm the current rate with your university. PG rates: scholarships.gov.in/public/FAQ/FAQsforICAR_NTS-PG_3104.pdf

scholarships.name: Financial Assistance for Education of Wards of Beedi/Cine/IOMC/LSDM Workers (Pre- & Post-Matric)
scholarships.provider: Ministry of Labour & Employment
scholarships.forWhom: Children of beedi, cine, iron/manganese/chrome ore mine (IOMC), limestone/dolomite mine (LSDM) and mica workers (including contract and home-based workers), from Class 1 to degree/professional courses, who passed the previous exam.
scholarships.amount: ₹1,000–₹3,000/yr (Class 1–12), ₹6,000/yr (ITI, polytechnic, degree), ₹25,000/yr (professional courses e.g. B.Tech, MBBS, MBA)
scholarships.deadline: NSP AY 2026-27: applications 1 Jun–31 Oct 2026 (per NSP listing); check portal for next cycle
scholarships.notes: Needs the parent's worker identity card. Rates read from the Hindi guideline on NSP: Class 1–4 ₹1,000; 5–8 ₹1,500; 9–10 ₹2,000; 11–12 ₹3,000. Income criteria not confirmed.

Single window for ~40 state schemes incl. Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulkh Shishyavrutti (EBC), Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Vasatigruh Nirvah Bhatta, GoI Post-Matric for SC/ST, VJNT/OBC/SBC post-matric and fee schemes, State Minority Scholarship, Eklavya and Open Merit scholarships. Amounts and income limits differ per scheme; the portal home page did not state them or a 2026-27 deadline.
scholarships.name: MahaDBT Scholarship Portal (Maharashtra state scholarships)
scholarships.provider: Government of Maharashtra (multiple departments via MahaDBT)
scholarships.forWhom: Maharashtra domicile students in post-matric courses; each scheme on the portal has its own category, marks and income rules.

scholarships.notes: 2026-27 pre-matric and post-matric timetables were issued on 20-07-2026 (dates shown on the portal's timetable section). OTR is mandatory from 2025-26. Income limits and amounts are set in category-wise rules (niyamavali) linked on the portal; not restated here.
scholarships.name: UP Scholarship and Fee Reimbursement (Pre-Matric and Post-Matric)
scholarships.provider: Government of Uttar Pradesh (Social Welfare, Backward Class Welfare, Minority Welfare, ST departments)
scholarships.forWhom: UP domicile students in Class 9-10 (pre-matric) or Class 11 onwards (post-matric) from SC, ST, OBC, minority and general categories, within income limits.

scholarships.deadline: 2026-27 window closed (15 Jul–30 Sep 2026)
scholarships.notes: Portal also links the SC-ST PMS portal. Income certificate must be dated on/after 01-04-2026. Amounts and income ceiling are not stated on the portal page.
